variants.debit-credit: Actual unsigned debits 12.34 and 100.00 at x360; unsigned credit 25.00 at x400. Exact signed nets -12.34,+25.00,-100.00 are computed once.
variants.fragmented: Date, amount and balance fragments use alternating Helvetica/Courier runs inside each published column interval.
variants.blank: Third page has no text or painting operators: visual blank.
variants.scan: Third page has a 1 by 1 raster painted at 400 by 150 PDF points: visual nontext, explicit review required.
variants.mixed: First text page also has the 1 by 1 raster: visual mixed, explicit review required.
variants.unknown: Third page has a 2 by 2 raster, exceeding configured maxImageSize 1: operator-list rejection, visual unknown required.
variants.rotated: Transaction date runs rotate 90 degrees: horizontal-layout rejection required.
variants.many-pages: 101 actual PDF pages: page-count rejection required before extraction.
